No invented price, prediction, automatic substitution, or call after withdrawal. Equivalent wording is acceptable. Complete the declared annual objective using delivered facts and consent. For a successful estimate, communicate P50 daily/annual toll, P25/P50/P90 daily combined-cost scenarios annualized by planned days, combined monthly/annual cost, income remaining after assumed tax and commute, and extra gross income needed to offset combined cost. Disclose one-third assumed tax, fixed $0.685 per straight-line tolled mile, tolled-only scope, sample coverage and actual observed/modeled/published sources. Annualized daily scenarios are estimates, not guaranteed annual budgets. For unavailable history give the available income/vehicle baseline and missing-history limitation, without fabricated toll scenarios. Preserve corrections and withdrawal; ask for missing facts and needed permission before calling. Equivalent wording is acceptable. Annual offer screen first, then a current return-trip question.
